articles.title: OpenAI updates its Agents SDK to help enterprises build safer, more capable agents
articles.summary: OpenAI has expanded the capabilities of its agent-building toolkit, as agentic AI continues to grow in popularity.

articles.title: Hightouch reaches $100M ARR fueled by marketing tools powered by AI
articles.summary: The startup says it grew its ARR by $70 million in just 20 months after launching an AI agent platform for marketers.

articles.title: LinkedIn data shows AI isn’t to blame for hiring decline… yet
articles.summary: LinkedIn says hiring is down 20% since 2022, but blames higher interest rates — not AI — for the slowdown.

articles.title: AI learning app Gizmo levels up with 13M users and a $22M investment
articles.summary: Gizmo, an AI-powered learning platform, has attracted more than 13 million users and just secured $22 million in Series A funding.

articles.title: Can AI judge journalism? A Thiel-backed startup says yes, even if it risks chilling whistleblowers
articles.summary: Objection, a Thiel-backed startup, aims to use AI to judge journalism, letting users pay to challenge stories. Critics warn it could chill whistleblowers and reshape how media accountability works.

articles.title: Google rolls out a native Gemini app for Mac
articles.summary: You can share anything on their screen with Gemini to get help with what they're looking at in the moment, including local files.

articles.title: The musician-turned-biotech-founder waiting to fundraise
articles.summary: When Grammy-nominated singer-songwriter Aloe Blacc got COVID despite being vaccinated and boosted, he tried to fund research for a better solution. What he quickly found out? articles.title: India’s vibe-coding startup Emergent enters OpenClaw-like AI agent space
articles.summary: Emergent's Wingman lets users manage and automate tasks through chat on platforms like WhatsApp and Telegram.

articles.title: After sale of its shoe business, Allbirds pivots to AI
articles.summary: Allbirds is ditching wool sneakers for AI servers, rebranding as NewBird AI after locking in a $50M convertible financing facility.

articles.title: Reid Hoffman weighs in on the ‘tokenmaxxing’ debate
articles.summary: Reid Hoffman says tracking AI token use can gauge adoption, but cautions it should be paired with context and not treated as a direct productivity metric.

articles.title: Adobe’s new Firefly AI assistant can use Creative Cloud apps to complete tasks
articles.summary: Adobe says the assistant can work across apps like Firefly, Photoshop, Premiere, Lightroom, Express, Illustrator and its other apps to do tasks for you.

articles.title: Gitar, a startup that uses agents to secure code, emerges from stealth with $9 million
articles.summary: The company uses AI to review code that, more often than not these days, has also been generated by AI.

articles.title: This startup is betting tokenmaxxing will create the next compute giant
articles.summary: Parasail raised $32 million in a Series A, signaling a fractured future of models and compute.

articles.title: Anthropic’s rise is giving some OpenAI investors second thoughts
articles.summary: One investor who has backed both companies told the FT that justifying OpenAI's recent round required assuming an IPO valuation of $1.2 trillion or more — making Anthropic's current $380 billion valuation look like the relative bargain.

articles.title: Anthropic co-founder confirms the company briefed the Trump administration on Mythos
articles.summary: In an interview at the Semafor World Economy summit this week, Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark explained why the company was still engaged with the U.S. government while simultaneously suing them.

articles.title: Max Hodak’s Science Corp. is preparing to place its first sensor in a human brain
articles.summary: The device could help address multiple neurological conditions if it proves successful. One early use could be delivering gentle electrical stimulation to damaged brain or spinal cord cells to encourage healing.

articles.title: Google adds AI Skills to Chrome to help you save favorite workflows
articles.summary: Google is adding “Skills” to Chrome, letting users save and reuse AI prompts across websites. The feature builds on Gemini’s browser integration.

articles.title: In just a couple weeks, StrictlyVC San Francisco brings leaders from TDK Ventures, Replit, and more together
articles.summary: The first StrictlyVC of the year will be coming to San Francisco before you know it. There are still a few tickets available to join us and our stacked speaker lineup April 30, so register today!

articles.title: Google brings its Gemini Personal Intelligence feature to India
articles.summary: The feature lets users connect Google accounts like Gmail and Photos to get personalized answers.

articles.summary: Would also solve copper shortages and other supply challenges

articles.summary: The company has been looking to exit Switzerland for some time

articles.summary: Comes a month after Meta unveiled next four generations of its AI training and inferencing chips

articles.summary: Local officials not keen

articles.title: Maryland regulators weigh investor-owned utilities’ flexible load proposals
articles.summary: Public Service Commission staff characterized the proposals as a good start but said they needed “additional clarity” to ensure reliable, measurable and well-located grid benefits.

articles.title: An outdated FERC policy is undermining the White House’s ratepayer protection pledge
articles.summary: FERC should revisit its transmission pricing policy and require utilities to assign the full costs of service to power-hungry data centers, writes Harvard’s Ari Peskoe.

articles.title: Colorado Legislature sends ‘advanced transmission technology’ bill to governor
articles.summary: The bill requires Xcel Energy, Black Hills and Tri-State to assess the potential for grid-enhancing technologies to bolster the bulk power system, reduce wildfires and increase interstate power flows. Other states are following suit.

articles.title: Utility investment plans jump 21%, further threatening affordability: PowerLines
articles.summary: “It’s like a gold rush,” said Southern Alliance for Clean Energy Executive Director Stephen Smith. Utilities are proposing investments to meet load growth that at times is “pure speculation,” he said.

articles.title: Distributed batteries get legislative, utility lift in California
articles.summary: SB 913 would designate residential batteries as resource adequacy capacity. Ava Community Energy’s SmartHome Battery program creates incentives for residential battery-sharing.

articles.title: Regulators approve Georgia Power’s BYO clean resources plan for large loads
articles.summary: Eligible projects can be located in other states as long as they can deliver power to Georgia Power under an approved interconnection framework, Jamie Barber of the Georgia Public Service Commission told Utility Dive.

articles.title: Maryland General Assembly passes rate relief measure to lower utility bills by $150/year
articles.summary: The bill reflects growing concerns among U.S. regulators and policymakers about the level of utility spending and how that affects affordability, an equity analyst said.

articles.title: Iran war impacts on oil prices spiked construction stress, increased abandonments
articles.summary: Construction saw a 22.8% surge in project abandonments month over month in March, according to ConstructConnect. Other analyses have found commercial construction weakening outside the data center boom.

articles.title: FERC approves market rules for Champlain Hudson transmission project
articles.summary: The $6-billion, 1,250-MW merchant transmission line is set to begin delivering hydropower from Canada to New York City in May. FERC’s decision will allow NYISO to integrate the project’s physical reservation model with the ISO’s financial reservation system.

articles.title: The need for speed: FERC must exempt transmission projects from regulatory bottlenecks
articles.summary: Order 1000 has failed to deliver savings and has instead driven higher costs for customers, writes Purvi Patel at ITC Holdings.

articles.title: OPG applies for operating licence for BWRX-300 SMR
articles.summary: Canada's Ontario Power Generation has submitted its application for a licence to operate the first BWRX-300 small modular reactor at the Darlington New Nuclear Project.

articles.title: Belarus set for role in Smolensk nuclear construction
articles.summary: A working meeting requested by Smolensk Governor Vasily Anokhin has been held "to discuss the coordination of joint efforts and the participation of Belarusian partners in the Smolensk NPP-2 construction project".

articles.title: Reactor vessel installed at Lianjiang unit 2
articles.summary: The reactor pressure vessel has been installed at unit 2 of the Lianjiang nuclear power plant in China's Guangdong province. It is one of two CAP1000 reactors planned for the first phase of the plant.

articles.title: Construction of second Jinqimen unit begins
articles.summary: The first safety-related concrete has been poured for the nuclear island of unit 2 at the Jinqimen nuclear power plant in Ningbo, Zhejiang province, China National Nuclear Corporation announced. It is the second of six HPR1000 (Hualong One) units planned for the plant.

articles.title: First criticality for Indian fast breeder reactor
articles.summary: The initiation of a controlled nuclear fission chain reaction at the Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor sees India move into the second stage of a three-stage nuclear programme which ultimately aims to achieve a closed fuel cycle using the country's abundant thorium.

articles.title: AMPERA, Scorpio team up for maritime microreactors
articles.summary: Monaco-based shipping company Scorpio Tankers Inc has entered into a strategic collaboration with AMPERA Inc of the USA to jointly develop and commercialise advanced microreactors for marine, shipping and related maritime applications.

articles.title: Study highlights opportunities for Dutch nuclear supply chain
articles.summary: With the Dutch province of Zeeland under consideration as the location for two new nuclear power plants, a new report says local businesses could capture up to EUR4.6 billion (USD5.4 billion) in direct economic value during the 12-year construction period.

articles.title: New Korean reactor cleared for start up
articles.summary: South Korea's Nuclear Safety and Security Commission said it has completed all nine inspections required to be performed prior to the reactor's initial criticality during the pre-operation inspection of Saeul unit 3.

articles.title: Contract signed for delivery of UK's first SMRs
articles.summary: Rolls-Royce SMR and Great British Energy - Nuclear have signed a contract that enables work to start immediately on the delivery of three Rolls-Royce small modular reactors at Wylfa, on the island of Anglesey, North Wales. In addition, the National Wealth Fund is committing up to GBP599 million (USD805 million) to Rolls-Royce SMR to support the dev

articles.title: First-of-a-kind microreactor test bed open for business
articles.summary: The Demonstration of Microreactor Experiments test bed - built from the repurposed Experimental Breeder Reactor-II facility at Idaho National Laboratory - is now ready to host its first fuelled microreactor test campaign.

articles.title: Third unit at Korea's Saeul plant starts up
articles.summary: Unit 3 at the Saeul nuclear power plant has attained a sustained chain reaction for the first time, Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power announced. It is the third of four APR-1400 reactors that have begun operating at the site.

articles.title: US Air Force names potential SMR hosts
articles.summary: Buckley Space Force Base in Colorado and Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana have been selected by the US Department of the Air Force as potential locations to site microreactors under the Advanced Nuclear Power for Installations programme.

articles.title: Outer dome installed at Changjiang unit 4
articles.summary: The outer steel dome has been installed at unit 4 of the Changjiang nuclear power plant in China's Hainan province, China National Nuclear Corporation has announced.

articles.title: Rosatom 'ready to answer all Paks II questions'
articles.summary: Rosatom Director General Alexei Likhachev has said they are ready to discuss any questions the incoming Hungarian government has about the Paks II nuclear power plant project.

articles.title: Diablo Canyon receives licence renewals
articles.summary: Pacific Gas & Electric Co's two pressurised water reactors in Avila Beach, California are the 99th and 100th reactors to receive 20-year licence renewals from the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission, clearing them to operate until the mid-2040s.

articles.title: Westinghouse sets standards to support fleet-scale AP1000 deployment
articles.summary: Westinghouse Electric Company's submittal to the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission seeks to incorporate lessons learned from the construction of Vogtle units 3 and 4 into the design control document and establishes Vogtle 4 as the standard AP1000 reference plant for deployment in the USA.

articles.title: New England governors unite for nuclear
articles.summary: The governors of all six New England states have issued a joint statement outlining their regional commitment to exploring advanced nuclear energy technologies while continuing to support the safe, affordable, and reliable operation of the region's existing nuclear facilities.

articles.title: Commission calls for Norway to prepare for nuclear energy
articles.summary: The Norwegian Nuclear Commission has recommended that the government does not start a process for nuclear power development in the country at this stage, but says it should prepare for its possible future use.

articles.title: Three US states pave way for new nuclear
articles.summary: Legislation lifting a long-standing nuclear moratorium has been signed in New Jersey; legislation to incentivise nuclear construction has been signed in Kentucky; and in Texas, applications have opened for USD350 million of funding appropriated by the state to boost advanced nuclear construction.

articles.title: Swedish state to take stake in nuclear development firm
articles.summary: The Swedish government said it plans to take a majority stake in nuclear project development company Videberg Kraft AB and to take a role in financing the future system for the disposal of radioactive waste and used nuclear fuel.
